name: Glycogen Storage Disease Due to Muscle Phosphofructokinase Deficiency

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Diagnostic Criteria for Glycogen Storage Disease Type VII

criteria.description: Reduced or absent phosphofructokinase enzyme activity in muscle biopsy
Identification of pathogenic mutations in the PFKM gene
Exercise intolerance with muscle cramps and myoglobinuria
Excessive glycogen accumulation in muscle fibers on histology

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of reduced phosphofructokinase enzyme activity or pathogenic PFKM mutations plus clinical features of exercise intolerance
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Muscle biopsy and genetic testing are essential for definitive diagnosis.

imaging: Muscle MRI showing selective muscle involvement and fatty infiltration
other: Reduced phosphofructokinase enzyme activity in muscle biopsy
Histological evidence of glycogen accumulation in muscle fibers

distinguishingFeatures: Absence of second wind phenomenon in Tarui disease
Muscle biopsy showing ragged red fibers

redFlags: Recurrent myoglobinuria with risk of acute kidney injury
Severe exercise intolerance limiting daily activities
Progressive fixed muscle weakness or contractures
references: Orphanet: Glycogen storage disease due to muscle phosphofructokinase deficiency (ORPHA:371)
